gaps.explanation: Re-read p5 (printed p8, Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, GAAP), pp12-14 (printed pp44, 47-48, General Fund and nonmajor combining statements) and the budget schedules pp9-11, 15-30. Every governmental fund is in detail[] from its Budget and Actual - Budgetary Basis schedule; the printed budgetary actual totals add to 203,092,341 (= schedule_total). GAAP minus budgetary, from printed totals: General 131,090,317 (p5) - 130,710,322 (p9) = 379,995; Highway 12,296,222 (p5) - 10,994,281 (p28) = 1,301,941; Federal Grants 14,230,499 (p5) - 39,210,186 (p11) = -24,979,687 (p11 prints 'Revenue accruals' (24,979,688)); nonmajor 21,666,679 (p14) - 22,177,552 (sum of the 14 nonmajor budget schedule totals) = -510,873. That nonmajor difference includes amounts the budget schedules print as revenue but the GAAP combining statement prints under other financing: Mental Health 'County aid' 1,013,160 (p20) = Mental Health Transfers in 1,013,160 (p13); Weed Control 'Other receipts' 13,175 (p21) = Other income 475 + Sale of capital assets 12,700 (p13); County Property Management 'Other receipts' 5,200 (p23) = Sale of capital assets 5,200 (p14); Bridge and Special Road 'Other revenue' 18,675 (p27) = Sale of capital assets 18,675 (p14); plus budget-vs-GAAP differences such as Sinking Fund 203,134 vs 218,878. 379,995 + 1,301,941 - 24,979,687 - 510,873 = -23,808,624 = gap. Printed basis difference; detail lines stay as printed. No fix.

Budgetary schedule totals add to 165,420,594 (= schedule_total). Against the GAAP columns: General 112,524,975 (p10) + Veterans Aid 11,048 (p30) = 112,536,023 vs Total General 112,152,469 (p12): +383,554; Federal Grants 8,037,509 (p11) vs 10,971,902 (p5): -2,934,393 (p11 Expenditure accruals (3,262,706), Current year encumbrances 478,506); Highway 17,644,850 (p28) vs 21,721,699 (p5): -4,076,849; 14 nonmajor schedules 27,202,212 vs Total Nonmajor 24,484,470 (p14): +2,717,742 (e.g. Bridge and Special Road schedule 9,124,434 vs 6,196,114 on p14). 383,554 - 2,934,393 - 4,076,849 + 2,717,742 = -3,909,946, i.e. schedule 3,909,946 below the statement 169,330,540 = gap. Printed basis difference. No fix.

p5 Transfers in 21,998,965 = General 1,509,981 + Highway fund 7,783,916 + Nonmajor 12,705,068; p13-14 nonmajor: Mental Health 1,013,160, Weed Control 188,321, Building 11,966, County Property Management 11,532, Bridge & Special Road 6,146,484, Sinking Fund 5,333,605. Detail transfers in 20,985,805 hold all of these except Mental Health 1,013,160. That money is already in detail as the Mental Health budget schedule's revenue line 'County aid' 1,013,160 (p20; the schedule prints no transfer row), so adding a Mental Health Transfers In line would count it twice. Kept as printed. No fix.

p5 Other financing sources 'Leases' 376,063 (= JSON debt_proceeds) = General 225,871 + Federal Grants Fund 150,192 (Highway and Nonmajor '-'); p12 General Fund combining schedule prints Leases 225,871 in the General Fund column (Veterans Aid '-'). The budget schedules (p10 General, p11 Federal Grants) print no lease row, so neither amount is in detail[]. Added both as printed fund-column other-financing lines. Lease lines after the fix: 225,871 + 150,192 = 376,063 = debt_proceeds exactly. The 115,555 the gap file counts on the schedule side is detail line 'Proceeds from sale of capital assets' (General Fund budget schedule p10), which is sale of property, not debt: it belongs with JSON other_financing 153,454 (p5 'Proceeds from sale of capital assets' = General 116,879 + Nonmajor 36,575). So non-transfer other-financing detail after the fix = 491,618 vs debt_proceeds + other_financing = 529,517; the 37,899 difference is printed basis, not missing lines: General sale 115,555 budgetary (p10) vs 116,879 GAAP (p12) = 1,324; nonmajor sale 36,575 (p13-14: Weed Control 12,700, County Property Management 5,200, Bridge & Special Road 18,675) is already inside existing detail revenue lines on the budget schedules (Weed Control 'Other receipts' 13,175 p21, County Property Management 'Other receipts' 5,200 p23, Bridge and Special Road 'Other revenue' 18,675 p27), so adding them would double count. JSON debt_proceeds / other_financing figures are correct as printed.
